issues.body: The new parenthetical says this is "the same anonymous-class output-vocabulary gap as WebOnt-I5.5-005", but the audited WebOnt-I5.5-005 entry in this file says its conclusion uses owl:unionOf, which is outside EL and is skipped; the engine also emits no union/rdf:List cells. Merely having an anonymous conclusion node does not make the mechanisms the same. This weakens the accuracy of the permanent-divergence audit.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the comparison to WebOnt-I5.5-005, or explicitly contrast it: this hasSelf case is an in-profile anonymous-restriction reification/output gap, whereas WebOnt-I5.5-005 requires the outside-EL owl:unionOf/list vocabulary.
issues.title: Incorrectly equates the hasSelf output gap with WebOnt-I5.5-005

verdict.summary: The revised explanation is mostly supported: the focused CRs3 converse test exercises the real realization path, Names::self_concept has no dictionary term, and realization emits the self-loop rather than an rdf:type assertion to the anonymous restriction. However, the new final comparison mischaracterizes WebOnt-I5.5-005 as the same anonymous-class output-vocabulary gap. Its adjacent audited entry and the wave-2 disposition describe that case as owl:unionOf being outside EL, with no union/list extraction or emission. Round 1 had no findings, so this new documentation error is a regression.
